summary: Charming Medical Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing voluntary adoption of corporate governance enhancement measures. The measures include a one-year lock-up agreement with CEO/Chairman Kit Wong covering all her Class A ordinary shares, an election to no longer rely on foreign private issuer exemptions from Nasdaq governance rules, and the abolition of the company's dual-class share structure by surrendering and cancelling all 2,000,000 Class B ordinary shares (20 votes each) held by Ms. Wong for no consideration. Post-cancellation, Ms. Wong will hold ~68.19% of the 15,178,000 ordinary shares with one vote per share. A shareholder meeting will be convened to approve the abolition of the dual-class structure. The board believes these measures enhance shareholder protection.
